segment.description: South Fork Holston River below Boone Dam (Boone tailwater), Sullivan County
segment.boundaries: Short flashy reach from Boone Dam to the Fort Patrick Henry Reservoir head; TWRA regs for the reach are set under the Fort Patrick Henry rule (Boone Dam downstream to Louis Milhorn Bridge)

coldSource.notes: No reachable TVA document states Boone Dam's withdrawal structure type; TVA's Boone Reservoir health page shows poor forebay/mid-reservoir dissolved oxygen ratings (https://tva.com/environment/environmental-stewardship/water-quality/reservoir-health-ratings/boone-reservoir), consistent with strong stratification, but that is not direct evidence of release temperature. The strongest documented pattern is TWRA's own stocking program for this reach: cold-season only (Mar, Apr, Nov, Dec rainbow+brown per the owner-supplied 2026-09-17 TWRA workbook), the complement of what a cold year-round tailwater would receive.

holdover.detail: No agency or multiple-independent-angler documentation of summer holdover found in this pass.

wildPopulation.detail: No evidence of natural reproduction found in this pass; unknown.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: TWRA's stocking program for this exact reach is cold-season only (Mar, Apr, Nov, Dec) - a pattern that fits a summer-warm reach - but no temperature data or documented release type was found to settle it; the catalog's yearRound:true flag remains the owner's call.
